articles.title: Patented: 7-Eleven’s Item-Recognition Tech and 121 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: Irving-based 7-Eleven added to its intellectual property with a pair of patents the week of Sept. 29. The patents relate to its ongoing work on inventory tracking and computer-vision item recognition. One patent improves data prediction in systems that track when items are removed from locations.…

articles.title: UTA and UT Southwestern Researchers Use AI to Pinpoint Eye Disease ‘Control Switches’
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Texas at Arlington and UT Southwestern Medical Center in Dallas are using AI and advanced statistics to pinpoint the molecular “control switches” involved in several eye diseases. The diseases being studied include age-related macular degeneration, glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy. …

articles.title: Texas data center boom could erase decades of progress on air quality
articles.summary: A new report warns that the state’s air quality progress could be reversed by the end of the decade, especially if facilities use natural gas power.
